text: tuberculosis (TB) epidemiology, often want combine two complementary sources evidence: Module 1 (\(M_1\), Starting State Occupancy / LTBI Survey Data \(Y_1\)): Cross-sectional screening diagnostic survey data informing baseline latent TB infection (LTBI) prevalence \(\pi_{\text{diag}} = \text{logit}^{-1}(\alpha_{\text{diag}})\) diagnostic test accuracy (\(\text{sens}, \text{spec}\)). Module 2 (\(M_2\), Active TB Progression Survival Data \(Y_2\)): Longitudinal follow-data \((t_i, d_i)_{=1}^{N_{\text{surv}}}\) informing uncured progression density \(f_u(t \mid \psi)\) survival \(S_u(t \mid \psi)\) (hazard parameters \(\psi = (\lambda, \gamma)\)) alongside survival cohort’s uncured LTBI fraction \(\pi_{\text{surv}} = \text{logit}^{-1}(\alpha_{\text{surv}})\). datasets represent underlying target population without selection bias (\(\pi_{\text{diag}} = \pi_{\text{surv}}\)), Joint model pools information across modules. However, longitudinal progression cohort suffers selection bias, case-mix differences, incomplete follow-(\(\pi_{\text{surv}} \neq \pi_{\text{diag}}\)), naive joint pooling allows biased survival data \(Y_2\) corrupt LTBI prevalence estimate \(\pi_{\text{diag}}\). EvidSynthTB provides six synthesis strategies ("joint", "cut", "independent", "melding", "elastic", "tempered") together quantitative comparison tools (compare_evidsynth(), evaluate_comparison(), diagnose_feedback()).

title: Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis for TB Epidemiology
text: goal EvidSynthTB use Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis (MPES) CmdStan jointly modularly estimate latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) prevalence (\(\pi\)), imperfect diagnostic test sensitivity specificity (\(\text{sens}, \text{spec}\)), active TB progression hazard rates (\(\lambda, \text{shape}\)) via parametric mixture cure models.

title: Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis for TB Epidemiology
text: framework links two core epidemiological modules: Starting state occupancy & imperfect diagnostic testing (\(M_1\)): True baseline LTBI status \(Z_i \sim \text{Bernoulli}(\pi_i)\) observed \(K \ge 1\) imperfect diagnostic tests (e.g., IGRA, TST) sensitivity \(\text{sens}_k\) specificity \(\text{spec}_k\): \[p_{\text{pos}, , k} = \pi_i \, \text{sens}_k + (1 - \pi_i)(1 - \text{spec}_k)\] Active TB progression mixture cure model (\(M_2\)): truly infected individuals (\(Z_i = 1\), uncured fraction \(\pi_i\), positive predictive value \(\text{PPV}_i\) test-positive follow-cohort) risk progressing active TB uncured survival \(S_u(t)\) density \(f_u(t)\) ("gompertz", "weibull", "exponential"): \[L_{\text{surv}, } = \left[ \tilde{\pi}_i f_u(t_i) \right]^{d_i} \left[ (1 - \tilde{\pi}_i) + \tilde{\pi}_i S_u(t_i) \right]^{1 - d_i}\] Two-module LTBI active TB progression model flow diagram

previous_headings: Model Structure
title: Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis for TB Epidemiology
text: evidsynth_fit() compare_evidsynth() support six ways sharing cutting information LTBI diagnostic module active TB progression module: "joint": Full joint likelihood (\(\pi_{\text{diag}} = \pi_{\text{surv}}\)), supporting "population" coupling individual-level "latent_class" marginalization \(Z_i \\{0, 1\}\). "cut": True two-stage Bayesian cut model (Plummer 2015). Stage 1 fits ltbi_module.stan diagnostic/survey data alone; Stage 2 propagates Stage 1 posterior draws progression mixture cure model blocking feedback survival data back LTBI prevalence. "independent": Separate unlinked prevalence parameters \(\pi_{\text{diag}}\) \(\pi_{\text{surv}}\). "melding": Two-stage normal portal plug-(\(\hat{\mu}, \hat{\sigma}\) \(\text{logit}(\pi)\)). "elastic": Hierarchical coupling \(\text{logit}(\pi_{\text{surv}}) \sim \mathcal{N}(\text{logit}(\pi_{\text{diag}}), \tau^2)\) tuneable tau_couple. "tempered": Power-likelihood tempering weighting survival contribution w_temper \(\[0, 1]\).

title: Fit Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis Model for LTBI and TB Progression — evidsynth_fit
text: Links latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) diagnostic test / survey data active TB progression data using parametric mixture cure model CmdStan. Supports **published aggregate / surveillance report tables** (cumulative subgroup counts, UKHSA/ETS annual interval counts, digitized Kaplan-Meier life tables) **individual-level survival / linked test data**, imperfect diagnostic tests (`sens`, `spec`) six modular synthesis strategies (`"joint"`, `"cut"`, `"independent"`, `"melding"`, `"elastic"`, `"tempered"`).

code: evidsynth_fit(   prevalence_data = NULL,   progression_data,   model = c("cut", "independent", "joint", "melding", "elastic", "tempered"),   coupling = c("population", "latent_class"),   cohort_type = c("all", "pos_only"),   surv_dist = c("gompertz", "weibull", "exponential"),   imperfect_test = FALSE,   covariates = NULL,   t_horizon = 5,   priors = list(),   tau_couple = 0.5,   w_temper = 0.5,   t_lim = 20,   chains = 2,   n_iter = 1000,   n_burnin = 500,   n_thin = 1,   n_cut_subsamples = 25,   seed = 123,   refresh = 0 )

title: Fit Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis Model for LTBI and TB Progression — evidsynth_fit
text: prevalence_data Data frame tibble aggregate LTBI survey data (columns `y` `ltbi`/`n_pos` `n` `pop`/`n_migrant`, plus optional `test_id` covariates) /normal logit plug-summaries (`mu_hat` `sigma_hat`). Can `NULL` `progression_data` already contains group-level LTBI counts (`y` / `ltbi` / `n_pos`) individual-level test results (`x` / `x1`, `x2`, ...). progression_data Data frame tibble active TB progression data one four formats: **Published cumulative subgroup summary table:** columns `n` (    `pop` / `n_migrant`), `d` (`tb` / `n_tb`), optional `y` (`ltbi` /     `n_pos`), optional `t_end` (follow-duration, defaulting     `t_horizon`), optional subgroup covariates. **UKHSA / ETS annual interval surveillance table:** columns     `t_start` (`t0`), `t_end` (`t1`), `d` (`tb` / `n_tb` / `n.event`),     `n` (`pop` / `n_migrant`, initial cohort denominator). **Published Kaplan-Meier life table:** columns `t_start`/`t_end`     (`time`), `n_risk` (`n.risk`), `d` (`n.event`). **Individual-level survival data (IPD):** columns `t` (follow-    time `> 0`) `d` (`1` = active TB progression, `0` = right-censored),     plus optional individual diagnostic test columns (`x` `x1`, `x2`, ...). model Character. Synthesis model strategy: `"joint"` Full joint synthesis sharing baseline LTBI prevalence     (`alpha_surv = alpha_diag`). `"cut"` True two-stage Bayesian cut model (Plummer 2015): fits     Stage 1 LTBI diagnostic/survey data alone, propagates     posterior draws prevalence test accuracy Stage 2 survival     inference zero feedback survival prevalence. `"independent"` Disjoint modules separate independent     prevalence parameters `prev_diag` `prev_cf`. `"melding"` Two-stage normal portal approximation (`mu_hat`,     `sigma_hat` `logit(pi)`) combined progression survival     likelihood. `"elastic"` Hierarchical coupling     `logit(prev_cf) ~ Normal(logit(prev_diag), tau_couple)`. `"tempered"` Power-likelihood synthesis weighting progression     survival likelihood `w_temper` `(0, 1]`. coupling Character. diagnostic test results progression times coupled individual-level linked test data provided: `"population"` (modular population-level prevalence link) `"latent_class"` (individual-level marginalization person's latent LTBI state `Z_i`). cohort_type Character. `""` screened individuals followed progression (uncured fraction `prev_cf`), `"pos_only"` test-positive individuals followed (uncured fraction positive predictive value, `ppv_cf`). surv_dist Character. Parametric uncured survival family: `"gompertz"`, `"weibull"`, `"exponential"`. imperfect_test Logical. `TRUE`, estimates test sensitivity (`sens`) specificity (`spec`) `Beta(a_sens, b_sens)` `Beta(a_spec, b_spec)` priors. `FALSE`, fixes `sens_fixed` `spec_fixed`. covariates Optional character vector covariate column names include linear predictor `logit(pi)`. t_horizon Numeric (`> 0`). Default follow-duration (years) published cumulative subgroup summary tables `t_end` explicitly provided column. Default `5`. priors Named list prior hyperparameters overriding defaults (`mu_alpha`, `sigma_alpha`, `sigma_beta`, `mu_shape`, `sigma_shape`, `a_lambda`, `b_lambda`, `a_sens`, `b_sens`, `a_spec`, `b_spec`, `sens_fixed`, `spec_fixed`). tau_couple Numeric (`> 0`). Coupling standard deviation logit scale `model = "elastic"`. Default `0.5`. w_temper Numeric `[0, 1]`. Power-likelihood weight survival module `model = "tempered"`. Default `0.5`. t_lim Integer (`>= 1`). Maximum integer time horizon posterior predicted survival curves `S_pred[1:t_lim]`. Default `20`. chains Integer. Number MCMC chains. Default `2`. n_iter Integer. Total iterations per chain (post-warmup draws + `n_burnin`). Default `1000`. n_burnin Integer. Warmup iterations per chain. Default `500`. n_thin Integer. Thinning interval. Default `1`. n_cut_subsamples Integer. Number Stage 1 posterior draws propagate Stage 2 conditional HMC `model = "cut"`. Default `25`. seed Optional integer random seed. refresh Integer. CmdStan output refresh rate (`0` suppresses progress printing). Default `0`.
